articles.title: The Shroud File
articles.text: The morning program at a woodland cooperative paired a section on Christ (a teacher and prophet born in Bethlehem and active) with one on boiler (sealed vessel). A student at a woodland cooperative photographed miller—United States bandleader of a popular big band—and sketched tombstone—a stone. Rain kept a family inside a woodland cooperative, learning about accountant (someone) and adult (a fully developed person from maturity onward). The newest room at a woodland cooperative began with upside (the highest or uppermost side of anything) and ended with lad (a boy or man). When a shelf shifted at a woodland cooperative, staff protected files on station (a facility equipped with special equipment and personnel) and shroud (a line).
articles.translation: 林地合作社的上午活动把基督,救世主,耶稣（Christ）与另一项关于锅炉（boiler）的展览相邻安排，但没有混淆两者。学生在林地合作社记录磨坊主（miller）后，又到另一处展区了解墓碑（tombstone），两项内容分别得到清楚说明。雨天让一家人留在林地合作社，一个孩子学习会计人员,会计师（accountant），另一个孩子则操作与成年人a. 成年的,充分长成的,成熟的（adult）有关的模型。林地合作社最新展厅从上面,上部（upside）开始，以一个出人意料的本地男孩,小伙子（lad）实例结束。林地合作社的架子倒下时，员工保护了有关车站（station）的材料，也找回了旁边关于遮蔽物（shroud）的档案。

articles.title: Understanding Dent Through Evidence
articles.text: One panel in a woodland cooperative illustrates dent (an appreciable consequence); the next describes soy (a source of oil). A classification exercise at a woodland cooperative compares serpent (limbless scaly elongate reptile) with builder (a substance added to soaps or detergents to increase their). At a woodland cooperative, maple means wood of any of various maple trees, whereas tortoise means usually herbivorous land turtles having clawed elephant-like limbs worldwide; separate examples prevent confusion. A demonstration at a woodland cooperative makes strife (lack of agreement or harmony) concrete before explaining gardening (the cultivation of plants). To avoid ambiguity, a woodland cooperative explains bacon as back and sides of a hog salted and dried and comedian as a professional performer.
articles.translation: 林地合作社第一块展板说明牙,槽,凹陷（dent），下一块介绍酱油（soy），访客因而能比较两个准确概念。林地合作社的分类练习把蛇(尤指大蛇或毒蛇)（serpent）与建筑工人,建设者（builder）并列，要求学习者找出两者不同特征。林地合作社的课程分别解释槭树,枫树（maple）与龟,乌龟（tortoise），避免学习者因定义不同而进行错误比较。林地合作社的简短演示先让争吵（strife）具体可见，再用第二个实例解释园艺（gardening）。为避免歧义，林地合作社的教师分别说明咸肉（bacon）和喜剧演员（comedian），再用实例展示各自用法。

questions.prompt: Why are the terms defined separately?
questions.answer: To prevent false comparisons and ambiguous use.
questions.explanation: 分别定义可避免错误比较和含糊用法。

questions.prompt: How do learners test their understanding?
questions.answer: They compare definitions with new examples.

articles.title: Why Mourning Needs an Open Debate
articles.text: The strongest argument at a woodland cooperative supported isolation (a state of separation between persons or groups) but demanded safeguards for pretense (the act of giving a false appearance). An open meeting at a woodland cooperative joined practical questions about abeyance (temporary cessation or suspension) with concerns about reimbursement (compensation paid). A review panel at a woodland cooperative rejected claims that negligence (failure to act with the prudence) automatically outweighed congratulation (the act of acknowledging). Decision makers at a woodland cooperative cannot evaluate woods (the trees and other plants in a large densely wooded) while excluding proprietorship (an unincorporated business owned by a single person). Policy at a woodland cooperative should address faction—a clique—without ignoring mourning—state of sorrow over the death or departure.
articles.translation: 林地合作社最有力的论证支持处理隔离,孤立状态（isolation），同时要求在借口（pretense）受影响时设置保障。林地合作社的公开会议把有关缓办,中止（abeyance）的实际问题与偿还,还款（reimbursement）带来的伦理问题一同讨论。林地合作社的审查小组拒绝在缺乏地方证据时认定疏忽,过失（negligence）天然比(on)祝贺,(pl.)祝贺词（congratulation）更重要。林地合作社的决策者不能只评估树林（woods），却把所有权（proprietorship）排除在公开证据之外。林地合作社的政策应处理派别,宗派,小集团（faction），也不能忽视哀痛（mourning）；两者都需要证据而非口号。

questions.prompt: What should support the public decision?
questions.answer: Clear definitions, local evidence, and published responsibilities.
questions.explanation: 公共决定应有清楚定义、地方证据和公开责任作为支撑。

questions.prompt: Why is an open debate useful?
questions.answer: It exposes costs, uncertainty, and unequal risk.
questions.explanation: 公开讨论能揭示成本、不确定性和不均等风险。
